decision.subject: Fully zero-based re-derived execution sequencing for masterplan v2 (/specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2.sequencing)
decision.dispatch_state_at_ratification: no execution wave had dispatched when this decision was recorded; ratification precedes all wave dispatch as required by the consolidation directive

ratification_authority.basis: Founder-authored masterplan-v2 consolidation directive (Seed contract, 2026-07-02) for the masterplan-v2-fabric-loop effort, which requires the consolidated plan to carry fully zero-based re-derived sequencing ratified by the founder before any execution wave dispatches.
founder_identity_provenance: HANDOFF.md (owner: founder; PAUSE-AND-PAIR canon ratification is founder sign-off authority)
ratification_authority.scope_limit: This ratification binds only to the exact sequencing content identified by ratified_sequencing_digest. Any mutation of masterplan_v2.dependency_edges, sequencing.work_item_order, or sequencing.execution_waves work_item_ids invalidates this record and requires a fresh re-derivation and a fresh founder-ratification record before further wave dispatch.

digest_recipe: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':') of {"dependency_edges": sorted [from, to] pairs from masterplan_v2.dependency_edges, "execution_waves": the work_item_ids arrays of masterplan_v2.sequencing.execution_waves in wave order, "work_item_order": the work_item_id strings of masterplan_v2.sequencing.work_item_order in index order}

derivation.wave_rule: wave(n) = 0 when n has no prerequisite edges in masterplan_v2.dependency_edges; otherwise 1 + max(wave(prerequisite)) over all prerequisites of n. Within a wave, items order lexicographically by work-item id. work_item_order is the wave-major concatenation of that ordering with contiguous zero-based indices.
inherited_orderings_ignored: docs/MASTERPLAN.md and docs/ROADMAP.md milestone/phase ordering (projections/provenance; not imported)
.omc/ultragoal/goals.json goal ordering (local-only harness store; not imported)
hermes board column/priority ordering (~/.hermes/kanban/boards/oyatie/kanban.db; forensic ingest only, ordering not imported)

reviewed_one_way_door_adrs: ADR-0328 substance bar canonical sequence and batch discipline
accepted_adr_contradiction_review.rationale: Hard orderings mandated by accepted ADRs enter the derivation as explicit dependency edges (relationships canonical-build-phase-ordering, realignment-wave-ordering, production-100-bar-definition-gates-all-roadmap-phases, cloud-ci-required-context-precedes-scm-cutover/cd-cutover). The zero-based derivation therefore preserves every accepted-ADR ordering constraint by construction; only legacy sequence indices were discarded. No supersession ADR is required for this ratification because the re-derived order contradicts no accepted ADR.

verification.fail_closed_contract: evaluate_masterplan_v2_sequencing keeps execution-wave dispatch fail-closed: absent or incomplete founder-ratification records emit masterplan_execution_wave_dispatch_unratified, and requires_founder_ratification=true / allowed_without_founder_ratification=false remain mandatory in masterplan_v2.sequencing.execution_wave_dispatch regardless of ratification state.

provenance_and_verification_correction_2.reason: The original record preserved authority and validator paths that were current at ratification time, and its scope sentence overstated the adjacent endpoint-pair digest recipe. Repository authority entrypoints and the cross-artifact agreement capability were subsequently consolidated and relocated. This dated correction supplies current read paths and precise digest coverage without rewriting the historical decision, recipe, digest, or derivation.

digest_scope_clarification.reason: The historical scope_limit sentence said any dependency_edges mutation invalidates the digest, while the adjacent founder-recorded digest_recipe hashes only sorted [from, to] endpoint pairs. This clarification removes that overclaim without changing the decision, recipe, or digest.
digest_scope_clarification.effective_scope: The ratification is content-addressed to dependency-edge from/to endpoint pairs, execution-wave work_item_ids in wave order, and work-item ids in index order. A covered-field mutation invalidates ratification. Relationship labels and other dependency-edge metadata are not hashed and must not be represented as digest-covered.
digest_scope_clarification.sequencing_semantics: The relationship label documents why an endpoint pair exists; the endpoint pair itself carries the prerequisite topology used by the ratified wave derivation. A relationship-only edit does not change the content-addressed sequencing and is outside this ratification record.

historical_pointer_disposition.HANDOFF.md: The original founder-identity provenance statement is retained as ratification-time history. HANDOFF.md is now a founder-authorized thin redirect and is not current plan or lifecycle authority.
historical_pointer_disposition.cloud/cloud-ci/gates/oya-cloud-ci-cross-: Historical pre-reorganization path. Current owned capability path is ci/facade/cross-artifact-agreement. The path correction alone makes no implementation-completion claim.

current_verification_pointers.current_fail_closed_scope: The combined validators compare the computed canonical sequencing digest with both /specs/masterplan.json and this evidence record, require a complete founder-ratification record, and keep execution-wave dispatch blocked while the separate 2026-07-13 pre-planning authority contract is open.

preplanning_hold.effect: The 2026-07-02 sequencing ratification remains valid for its unchanged digest, but does not override the later pre-planning authority hold or authorize dispatch by itself.

provenance_and_verification_correction_2.claim_ceiling: This correction re-points current authority and verification reads only. It does not re-ratify or broaden the sequencing decision, Accept any Proposed ADR, close the pre-planning contract, admit the current PR candidate, or authorize execution-wave dispatch.
